 Bath & Body Works’ $50 Advent Calendar Has a Tiny Cookie-Sheet Holder and Seven Full-Size Finds
 By
 Jamie Slack
 November 5, 2026 
 Why you can trust this post 
 This post may contain affiliate links. For more information, please read our affiliate disclosure policy . 
 The tiny cookie-sheet sanitizer holder is doing a lot of work here. Little gingerbread cookies, a miniature oven mitt, absolutely no oven to preheat. Bath & Body Works tucked it into a holiday countdown that also includes socks, a candle and a very sparkly tree charm.
 The Feel the Wonder Advent Calendar costs $50 and drops November 16, 2026, at 2 p.m. Eastern, noon Mountain. The official page currently offers a reminder signup.
 The candle, socks and cookie-sheet holder are among the first six gifts shown. Photo: Bath & Body Works. ‹ 1 / 2 › 
 The other six include a tote and a present-shaped Wallflowers plug. Photo: Bath & Body Works. ‹ 2 / 2 › 
 It is 12 days, with more than body care inside
 Bath & Body Works says seven items are full-size and seven are exclusive. Those are separate counts. The mix leans into home fragrance and accessories, so this is a better match for someone who enjoys the whole store than someone shopping strictly for lotion.
 What is inside? Spoilers ahead
 Here is the brand’s listed assortment:
 Winter single-wick candle, 8 ounces
 Red lounge socks
 Sweater Weather sanitizer, 1 fluid ounce
 Cookie-sheet sanitizer holder
 Winter Candy Apple mist, 2.5 fluid ounces
 Fresh Balsam room spray, 1.5 ounces
 Glitter-tree bag charm/keychain
 Snowflakes & Cashmere hand cream, 1 fluid ounce
 Champagne Toast body wash, 3 fluid ounces
 Candy-stripe packable tote
 Present-stack Wallflowers plug
 ’Tis the Season Wallflowers refill, 0.8 fluid ounce
 The fun of a countdown is opening something different each day. If a plug-in, tote and pair of socks sound like welcome surprises, this assortment has range. If you are hoping for twelve bottles of perfume, keep browsing.
 For other kinds of countdowns, our 2026 Advent calendar guide includes beauty, food, toys and a few wonderfully odd options.
